name: dsh-agents-manager
description: AI enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness (settings page shown as "MCP & Skills"): visual management of MCP servers, Skills, subagent roles & model pools, automatic model-request retry (provider policies + vendor-expression rules + cross-restart monitor), and per-session service-process panels — settings pages, ~/.agents config, MCP testing, tools & per-card enable toggles, skill editing, delegation roles with per-call model selection, and the report_service_process callback tool.
